messages:
jordan_support: FYI got an escalation from ACME Prod earlier — they started seeing noticeably different generations from our ap-northeast-1 (apn1) / SG cluster after last night's canary. Shorter replies, more hallucinations, and intermittent 502s. Also seeing token latency spikes.

liam_infra: can you paste the customer repro + the exact model and version they hit? do we have the cluster id?

jordan_support: here's the customer report thread I pasted: 'After the rollout we see shorter, sometimes contradicting outputs for the same prompts. Example prompt: "Summarize this contract clause" now returns 2-3 sentence summaries vs 6-8 before. Also some requests return 502 with message "auth failure" even though token is valid.' They say requests that hit apn1-eu-sg-02 are the ones failing. Model: gpt-redwood-1.1.2-quant.

anya_ml: thanks. gpt-redwood-1.1.2-quant — that would have switched kernel selection to the new int8 path in last night's rollout. possible precision/regression on that HW. any hardware differences for apn1-eu-sg-02?

deploy-bot: Deployment event: canary rollout gpt-redwood-1.1.2 -> 1.1.3 (quant kernel opt) started at 2026-03-16T23:45:12Z. Targets: apn1 clusters: apn1-eu-sg-01, apn1-eu-sg-02, apn1-eu-sg-03. Canary %: 20%.

observability-bot: Alert: increased 5xx rate on apn1-eu-sg-02 between 2026-03-17T00:10:00Z and 2026-03-17T00:40:00Z. 5xx spike + latency P95 token generation +120% vs baseline.

liam_infra: can you capture a minimal repro? jordan, easiest is a curl that the customer used. also need the auth error body.

jordan_support: customer provided this minimal repro and outputs — they said running the same request twice in a row sometimes returns different length and sometimes a 502: 

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1.1.2-quant","input":"Summarize: The tenant must pay all utilities...","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.2}'
```

Success output (before rollout sample): ``"summary":"The tenant is responsible for utilities... (6 sentences)"``

After rollout (apn1-eu-sg-02 sample): ``"summary":"Tenant pays utilities."``

Intermittent 502 body: ``{"error":"auth failure","code":502}`` — token works for other clusters.

anya_ml: thanks — that looks like both a quality delta and a separate 502 path. 502 auth body is odd; could be upstream proxy misclassifying kernel crash as auth. are there any kernel OOMs or cgpu driver faults in that host?

liam_infra: checking node telemetry... apn1-eu-sg-02 is on H100.p4c (packed) while apn1-eu-sg-01 is on A100.GPU. The quant kernel had a backend path that uses fused kernels optimized for H100 that landed in 1.1.3. I see repeated worker restarts around 00:12Z on that node and a handful of segmentation fault traces in the runtime logs. Might explain 502s.

anya_ml: segmentation faults => likely kernel selection bug for H100 int8 path changing model behavior (fallbacks/regression). different GPU/float emulation could affect output length. we should repro locally on H100 with the same runtime flags.

liam_infra: immediate mitigation: revert canary on apn1-eu-sg-02 and pin traffic to apn1-eu-sg-01/03 or rollback model to 1.1.2 on that node. can we flip routing for this customer to avoid apn1-eu-sg-02?

jordan_support: ACME is sensitive. I'll ask them to allow us to pin them to 1.1.2 for now and offer credit. pinging @liam_infra and @anya_ml for rollback.

liam_infra: doing emergency revert for apn1-eu-sg-02 now — rolling back to gpt-redwood-1.1.2-quant. ETA ~3m.

deploy-bot: Rollback event: apn1-eu-sg-02 -> gpt-redwood-1.1.2-quant completed at 2026-03-17T00:28:01Z.

observability-bot: Alert resolved: 5xx rate normalized on apn1-eu-sg-02 after rollback. Latency P95 returned to baseline.

anya_ml: next steps: run unit tests on the int8 H100 path, reproduce the segfault with sanitizer build, and add a canary gate that verifies output-length distributions on mixed-GPU canaries. I'll open an RFC for patch + extra goodness.

jordan_support: ACME confirmed behavior returned to previous baseline after we pinned them/rollback. They want root cause and timeline. I'll prepare a customer-facing summary once you have RCA. :thumbsup:

liam_infra: noted, will attach logs and the segfault stack in the postmortem. thanks all.
